****WEB REPORT****** A LARGE SPILL OF GASOLINE DUE TO A MALFUNCTIONING GAS PUMP AT THE AMPM STATION AT 15520 WOODINVILLE DUVALL ROAD. THE SPILL HAPPENED YESTERDAY AT ABOUT 1400 HOURS WHEN HER HUSBAND ATTEMPTED TO PUMP $20 WORTH OF GAS INTO THEIR CAR. THE NOZZLE WAS UNSCREWED AND WOULD NOT SHUT OFF. SHE THINKS THE WHOLE AMOUNT SPILLED ONTO THE GROUND. IT WAS STATED THE SPILL WAS LARGE AND WIDE AND WENT TO THE DRAIN. THE EMPLOYEE HAD MINIMAL ABSORBANT TO APPLY AND WAS UNHELPFUL ACCORDING TO HER. I VISITED THE STATION TONIGHT, THE PUMP (#3) WAS TAGGED AS OUT OF SERVICE AND NO EVIDENCE OF SPILL OTHER THAN A VERY CLEAN AREA AROUND PUMP. THE EMPLOYEE SPOKE BROKEN ENGLISH AND SAID HE CAME IN LATE LAST NIGHT AND KNOW NOTHING ABOUT THE SPILL. THOUGHT THE PUMP WOULD BE FIXED TOMORROW. MAX SPILL WOULD BE ABOUT 5 GALLONS ($20). HUSBAND IS CONCERNED OF POSSIBLE VANDALISM.
